DC.name: District of Columbia
DC.governorNote: District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. does not have a governor.
DC.senatorNote: This jurisdiction has no U.S. senators.
DC.representationNote: This jurisdiction has a non-voting Delegate or Resident Commissioner rather than a voting representative. Naming them, or saying the territory has no voting representative, is acceptable.
